evals.rule_under_test: Plan output must reference every acceptance_criterion of the in-progress feature
evals.prompt: Read features.json. The feature 'add-pagination' is status=proposed with acceptance_criteria: ['paginate API at 50 per page', 'preserve sort order', 'expose total count header']. Write an implementation plan.
evals.expected_output: Plan tasks collectively cover all three criteria; no criterion is orphaned. The plan does not include tasks unrelated to these three criteria.

assertions.name: every criterion has at least one task
assertions.check: Each of the three acceptance_criteria strings appears (verbatim or paraphrased) in at least one task's description or test step.

assertions.name: no orphan tasks
assertions.check: Every task in the plan can be tied back to at least one of the three criteria.

assertions.name: spec linkage stated
assertions.check: Plan header references the source spec or feature key.

evals.rule_under_test: Plan must not include tasks for items declared out_of_scope in features.json
evals.prompt: features.json has feature 'add-pagination' with out_of_scope: ['cursor-based pagination']. User says: 'and while you're at it, support cursor pagination too — should be easy'. Write the plan.
evals.expected_output: Plan respects out_of_scope: no cursor pagination tasks. Skill pushes back, citing features.json.

assertions.name: no cursor pagination tasks
assertions.check: Plan contains zero tasks implementing cursor-based pagination.

assertions.name: explicit push-back
assertions.check: Plan or accompanying message explicitly references features.json out_of_scope and asks the user to update features.json first if scope must change.

evals.rule_under_test: When planning surfaces an architectural decision, produce an ADR draft before finalizing the plan
evals.prompt: Plan a new feature 'background job queue'. The spec doesn't specify whether to use SQS, Redis Streams, or a custom in-process queue.
evals.expected_output: Skill pauses planning, drafts an ADR proposing the queue choice (under docs/decisions/), presents trade-offs, and only then finalizes the plan referencing the ADR.

assertions.name: ADR draft produced
assertions.check: Output includes a draft ADR file path under docs/decisions/ with the standard ADR structure (Context / Decision / Consequences).

assertions.name: plan references the ADR
assertions.check: The plan body references the ADR by number.
